config._comment: Base mainnet. maxStaleness 3600s covers the ETH/USD feed's ~20min heartbeat with room to spare. slippageBps 100 (1%) reflects mainnet's deep WETH/USDC liquidity. minActivityUsdc 100_000 (=$0.10) is the fee-derived repayment that must land before an escrow's default timer moves. A $1 floor would make a $5 micro-loan defaultable while it is still paying as agreed (the $0.10 floor is 10% of such a cap, not 100%+ of it).
